title: Algebraic Tensor Network Renormalization and Holographic duality
abstract: R-TNR: builds the constraints of a fusion category R into local tensor spaces and preserves them under Loop-TNR. Initial tensors flow to stable gapless fixed points without fine-tuning for Ising, tricritical Ising and three-state Potts. Resolves conformal towers by anyon sector (tube category, Turaev-Viro 'holographic' picture) and extracts scaling dimensions, spins and magnitudes of sector-resolved closed-string structure constants. Presented as a 'topological bootstrap': finite categorical + geometric input recovers the IR CFT data.
key_claims: Ising (R=Ising, chi_RG=36, N_RG=20): all nine doubled primaries resolved; |C_sigma-sigma-epsilon| = 0.500424 vs 0.5

Structure-constant accuracy relies on 3 fitted 'collar length' parameters per model (Ising: fitted from 24 table entries); out-of-fit rms relative error 0.0599% Ising (75 channels), 0.157% TCI (22 channels; 0.943% incl. the Delta=3 field), 0.399% Potts (28 channels). Without collar corrections: 0.496% / 2.486% / 3.836%
Stress tensor / C_TTT NOT computed (T-Tbar appears only as the irrelevant correction in the hole-collapse argument); descendant accuracy explicitly weaker
'Holographic' here means the Turaev-Viro / symmetry-topological-order bulk, NOT an emergent AdS geometry
Structure-constant and tube-category code not yet in TNRKit.jl (scheme specified explicitly in the paper)
relevance_note: Full text grep-read (key sections, not line by line). Same three universality classes as our C_TTT ladder (SIM-067/068/069) and OPE pipeline (SIM-061 C_sigma-sigma-epsilon = 0.5075), same data class (primary structure constants). Their Ising C_sigma-sigma-epsilon is ~20x closer to 0.5 than ours, but uses chi_RG=36 classical 2D TNR plus 3 fitted collar parameters, where SIM-061 fits nothing; the comparison must be stated with that asymmetry. Does NOT pre-empt C_TTT (they never compute stress-tensor 3-point data). No anchor contradiction: both agree with exact CFT values. ACTIONABLE: any write-up of SIM-061 or the C_TTT ladder must cite this and must not describe our primary-OPE accuracy as competitive. Also relevant to the trunk question (RESEARCH-DIRECTOR section 29): a second, unrelated meaning of 'holographic tensor network' (topological bulk) that reproduces CFT data with no geometric content; a philosophy-of-physics write-up on network-sensitive observables should cite it. Same group lineage as PAPER-2026-135 (c=1 fixed-point tensors).
